section_1_cloze.passage:
In 2010, I was new at a magazine and was sent to cover a surfing competition in the north of Scotland by plane. But before I [41], a volcano erupted. All planes were grounded and that left me [42].
I could have waited and rested, going back a few days later than expected. As an intern(实习生), I felt the urge to [43] myself. So I looked for [44] to get back to the office in Jenbach [45]. The only option was a train journey requiring transfers(换乘), which I'd never [46] before. When the train rolled out of Thurso station, I couldn't imagine how much I would [47] my first train ride.
Between Thurso and Inverness, I was amazed at the [48]. The train passed through wild highlands, rocky coasts and ancient villages. [49], this line is not even regarded as Scotland's prettiest train route. That [50] goes to the route between Glasgow and Mallaig. And as the train moved forward, I found myself [51] actively, exchanging thoughts and even snacks with fellows.
A train journey takes longer than flying; that's its [52]. You never know what will surprise you as the train travels through station after station. The [53] journey provides a perfect time for relaxation, which people always [54] due to the tight schedule. The journey took me over one day; it was tiring yet [55]. I completed my task, and discovered a new way of traveling.

questions.explanation: 根据前文作者被派往苏格兰北部报道冲浪比赛，以及后文想方设法回到(get back to)办公室可知，这里指在作者“返回”之前火山爆发了。此处需填入表示“返回”的动词。
questions.supplement:
A(arrived)：语境句：We arrived at the airport two hours before departure. 固定搭配：arrive at/in, arrive late
B(returned)：语境句：He returned to his hometown after graduating from university. 固定搭配：return to, in return
C(settled)：语境句：After years of traveling, they finally settled in a quiet village. 固定搭配：settle down, settle a dispute
D(reported)：语境句：The journalist reported the accident live from the scene. 固定搭配：report on, it is reported that

questions.explanation: 因为火山爆发所有航班停飞(All planes were grounded)，这导致作者被“困住”了。be stuck表示“被困住，陷入僵局”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(lost)：语境句：The little boy got lost in the crowded market. 固定搭配：get lost, be lost in thought
B(scared)：语境句：She was scared to death when she heard the weird noise. 固定搭配：be scared of, be scared to do
C(stuck)：语境句：We were stuck in heavy traffic for over an hour. 固定搭配：be/get stuck in, stuck with
D(desperate)：语境句：The desperate parents appealed for help to find their missing child. 固定搭配：be desperate for, be desperate to do

questions.explanation: 作为一名实习生(intern)，作者本来可以多等几天再回，但为了表现自己，作者迫切地想要“证明”自己(prove oneself)。
questions.supplement:
A(prove)：语境句：He worked hard to prove himself capable of the job. 固定搭配：prove oneself, prove to be
B(test)：语境句：The difficult situation will test our courage and patience. 固定搭配：stand the test of time, put to the test
C(free)：语境句：Technology has freed us from heavy physical labor. 固定搭配：free sb from, set sb free
D(praise)：语境句：The teacher praised the student for his excellent performance. 固定搭配：praise sb for sth, sing the praises of

questions.explanation: 航班取消了，为了按时回办公室，作者不得不寻找“替代方案(alternatives)”，即其他的交通方式。
questions.supplement:
A(alternatives)：语境句：Since the road is blocked, we have no alternatives but to take a detour. 固定搭配：have no alternative but to do, provide an alternative
B(appointments)：语境句：I have an appointment with my dentist this afternoon. 固定搭配：make an appointment, keep an appointment
C(adventures)：语境句：The young man set off on a thrilling adventure in the jungle. 固定搭配：a sense of adventure, go on an adventure
D(admissions)：语境句：Gaining admission to a top university requires great effort. 固定搭配：apply for admission, gain admission to

questions.explanation: 作者想要证明自己是一个尽责的实习生，因此急切寻找替代方案是为了能“按时(on time)”回到办公室。
questions.supplement:
A(by air)：语境句：Traveling by air is usually faster than by train. 固定搭配：travel by air, send by air
B(on time)：语境句：The train departed exactly on time despite the bad weather. 固定搭配：arrive on time, finish on time
C(at ease)：语境句：His comforting words made me feel entirely at ease. 固定搭配：feel at ease, put sb at ease
D(beyond doubt)：语境句：His dedication to the project is beyond doubt. 固定搭配：beyond doubt, without doubt

questions.explanation: 唯一选择是乘坐需要多次换乘的火车，这是作者以前从未“经历(experienced)”过的。
questions.supplement:
A(opposed)：语境句：Many local residents strongly opposed the building of the factory. 固定搭配：be opposed to, oppose doing sth
B(forgot)：语境句：I completely forgot to turn off the lights before leaving. 固定搭配：forget to do, forget doing
C(completed)：语境句：She successfully completed her project ahead of schedule. 固定搭配：complete a task, complete with
D(experienced)：语境句：He experienced many hardships during his early years. 固定搭配：experience failure, fully experienced

questions.explanation: 从下文描述的沿途美景和带来的放松感可知，这趟旅程远超预期。作者在火车开出时，无法想象自己日后会有多“珍视(value)”这第一次火车之旅。
questions.supplement:
A(value)：语境句：I highly value your advice on my career choices. 固定搭配：value highly, value friendship
B(expand)：语境句：The company is planning to expand its business into overseas markets. 固定搭配：expand on, expand business
C(advocate)：语境句：Many experts advocate rewarding children for good behavior. 固定搭配：advocate doing sth, strongly advocate
D(affect)：语境句：The unexpected rain will certainly affect our outdoor activities. 固定搭配：deeply affect, negatively affect

questions.explanation: 后一句提到“火车穿过了荒野高地、多岩石的海岸和古老的村庄”，这些都属于自然“风景(scenery)”。作者对沿途风景感到惊叹。
questions.supplement:
A(facility)：语境句：The hotel offers excellent sports facilities for its guests. 固定搭配：public facilities, medical facilities
B(speed)：语境句：The car was traveling at a very high speed when the accident happened. 固定搭配：at top speed, speed up
C(atmosphere)：语境句：The restaurant is famous for its romantic atmosphere. 固定搭配：create an atmosphere, friendly atmosphere
D(scenery)：语境句：We stopped on the way to admire the spectacular mountain scenery. 固定搭配：beautiful scenery, enjoy the scenery

questions.explanation: 前文刚提到沿途风景绝美令作者惊叹，本句却说这条线甚至不被认为是苏格兰最美的火车路线。前后形成转折与预期反差，故填“令人惊讶地(Surprisingly)”。
questions.supplement:
A(Interestingly)：语境句：Interestingly, the twins have completely different personalities. 固定搭配：interestingly enough, interestingly written
B(Naturally)：语境句：Naturally, parents want the best for their children. 固定搭配：come naturally to, naturally occurring
C(Surprisingly)：语境句：Surprisingly, he passed the difficult exam with flying colors. 固定搭配：surprisingly well, somewhat surprisingly
D(Fortunately)：语境句：Fortunately, no one was injured in the terrible car crash. 固定搭配：fortunately for sb, turn out fortunately

questions.explanation: 前一句提到“最美路线”这个头衔，本句承接说这一“荣誉(honour)”属于格拉斯哥到马莱格的路线。go to表示“属于，被归于”。
questions.supplement:
A(reward)：语境句：Hard work will eventually bring you a great reward. 固定搭配：in reward for, as a reward
B(honour)：语境句：It is a great honour to be invited to speak at the conference. 固定搭配：in honour of, have the honour to do
C(secret)：语境句：The secret to success lies in persistence and hard work. 固定搭配：keep a secret, the secret to
D(opportunity)：语境句：You should seize the opportunity to study abroad. 固定搭配：take the opportunity, provide an opportunity

questions.explanation: 空后紧跟的动作是“与同车人交流思想甚至交换零食(exchanging thoughts and even snacks with fellows)”，这是在积极地进行“互动(interacting)”。
questions.supplement:
A(wandering)：语境句：He spent the afternoon wandering aimlessly around the city. 固定搭配：wander around, wander off
B(working)：语境句：She has been working tirelessly on this project for months. 固定搭配：work out, work on
C(interacting)：语境句：Children learn a lot by interacting with their peers. 固定搭配：interact with, interact closely
D(changing)：语境句：The world is changing at an unprecedented pace. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better

questions.explanation: 坐火车比坐飞机耗时更长，正常情况下是缺点，但后文说它提供了惊喜和放松的完美时间，说明作者认为耗时长反而是火车旅行的“吸引力/魅力(appeal)”。
questions.supplement:
A(appeal)：语境句：The quiet countryside has lost its appeal for the young people. 固定搭配：have wide appeal, lose its appeal
B(power)：语境句：Knowledge is power, which can change a person's destiny. 固定搭配：come to power, in one's power
C(fault)：语境句：It is not your fault that the machine stopped working. 固定搭配：find fault with, at fault
D(challenge)：语境句：Learning a new language is a great challenge but highly rewarding. 固定搭配：face a challenge, meet a challenge

questions.explanation: 结合上一段“A train journey takes longer...”以及本段末尾“The journey took me over one day”，可知这是一段“延长的、漫长的(extended)”旅程，恰好给了人们充足的时间放松。
questions.supplement:
A(expected)：语境句：The results were better than we had expected. 固定搭配：be expected to do, as expected
B(extended)：语境句：He took an extended leave from work to care for his sick mother. 固定搭配：extended family, extended period
C(predictable)：语境句：The movie's plot was entirely predictable from the very beginning. 固定搭配：highly predictable, easily predictable
D(variable)：语境句：The weather in spring is highly variable and hard to forecast. 固定搭配：variable costs, highly variable

questions.explanation: 由于日程安排紧凑(tight schedule)，人们通常会把放松这件事“推迟(put off)”。火车旅行由于时间长，强制给人提供了这段放松时间。
questions.supplement:
A(rely on)：语境句：You can always rely on him to help you out in emergencies. 固定搭配：rely heavily on, rely on oneself
B(refer to)：语境句：The speaker often referred to his notes during the presentation. 固定搭配：refer to A as B, in reference to
C(care about)：语境句：True friends care about your feelings and support you unconditionally. 固定搭配：care deeply about, not care less about
D(put off)：语境句：Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today. 固定搭配：put off doing sth, be put off by

questions.explanation: 这段旅程花了一天多，很累人(tiring)，但句中有转折词yet，且后文说“我完成了任务并发现了新的旅行方式”，说明作者觉得这趟旅程是“值得的(worthwhile)”。
questions.supplement:
A(heartwarming)：语境句：The documentary tells a heartwarming story of a stray dog finding a home. 固定搭配：a heartwarming story, heartwarming news
B(flexible)：语境句：We need a more flexible schedule to accommodate sudden changes. 固定搭配：flexible working hours, highly flexible
C(worthwhile)：语境句：Volunteering at the hospital proved to be a worthwhile experience. 固定搭配：worthwhile effort, make sth worthwhile
D(inspirational)：语境句：The coach gave an inspirational speech before the championship game. 固定搭配：inspirational quote, inspirational figure

vocab_pack.definition_en: to report on an event or topic for a newspaper, TV, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'was sent to cover' 中，cover 为不定式作目的状语，主语是 I，被动语态。
vocab_pack.example_en: The journalist was assigned to cover the international summit.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位记者被派去报道国际峰会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was sent to cover a surfing competition

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of a volcano) to explode and send out hot melted rock, ash, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'a volcano erupted' 中，erupted 为一般过去时，主语第三人称单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: The volcano erupted violently after decades of silence.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那座火山在沉寂了几十年后猛烈喷发。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to prevent an aircraft from taking off
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'All planes were grounded' 中，grounded 为过去分词构成被动语态，表示被停飞。
vocab_pack.example_en: The heavy fog grounded all flights at the airport.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大雾使机场所有航班停飞。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to be in a difficult or immobile situation
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使某人陷入困境/被困住
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'left me stuck' 中，left 为 leave 的过去式，后接宾语 me 和形容词 stuck 作宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The snowstorm left us stuck in the village for three days.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 暴风雪使我们被困在村里三天。

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to express that something was possible in the past but did not happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'I could have waited' 是虚拟语气，表示过去有能力或有机会做但实际未做；'could have + 过去分词' 结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: I could have left earlier but I chose to stay.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我本可以早点离开，但我选择留下。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I could have waited and rested

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a strong desire to do something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 有强烈的欲望/冲动做某事
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'felt the urge to prove myself' 中，felt 为过去式，后接名词 urge 和不定式 to prove。
vocab_pack.example_en: He felt the urge to travel around the world after graduation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他毕业后有周游世界的强烈冲动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I felt the urge to prove myself

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show that one has the ability, quality, etc. that is expected
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'to prove myself' 中，prove 是不定式，myself 是反身代词，与主语一致。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new employee worked hard to prove himself in the team.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新员工努力工作以在团队中证明自己。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to search for other options or choices
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 寻找替代方案/其他选择
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'looked for alternatives' 中，looked 为过去式，for 是介词，alternatives 是名词复数作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should look for alternatives to reduce the cost.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该寻找替代方案以降低成本。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I looked for alternatives to get back to the office

vocab_pack.definition_en: to need changes from one vehicle/train to another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'a train journey requiring transfers' 中，requiring 为现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰 journey。
vocab_pack.example_en: This ticket requires transfers at two different stations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这张票需要在两个不同的车站换乘。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move slowly out of a place (especially a train departing a station)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'rolled out of Thurso station' 中，rolled 为过去式，out of 是介词短语，表示离开某地。
vocab_pack.example_en: The train rolled out of the station right on time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 火车准时驶出了车站。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the train rolled out of Thurso station

vocab_pack.definition_en: to consider something as important and worth having
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'would value my first train ride' 中，value 为动词原形，与 would 构成过去将来时。
vocab_pack.example_en: I value the time I spend with my family very much.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我非常珍惜和家人在一起的时光。
vocab_pack.from_passage: how much I would value my first train ride

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be very surprised or impressed by something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'I was amazed at the scenery' 中，was amazed 为系表结构（被动含义的形容词），at 引出对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: The tourists were amazed at the beauty of the ancient temple.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 游客们对古庙的美丽感到惊叹。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was amazed at the scenery

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go through a place on the way to another destination
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'passed through wild highlands' 中，passed 为过去式，through 是介词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hiking trail passes through dense forests and open fields.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这条徒步小径穿过茂密的森林和开阔的田野。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The train passed through wild highlands

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be considered or thought of as something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'is not even regarded as' 中，regarded 为过去分词构成被动语态，as 为介词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is regarded as one of the leading experts in the field.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她被认为是该领域的顶尖专家之一。
vocab_pack.from_passage: this line is not even regarded as Scotland's prettiest train route

vocab_pack.definition_en: attractive, nice to look at (superlative: prettiest)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 漂亮的，好看的（最高级：最漂亮的）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'Scotland's prettiest train route' 中，prettiest 是形容词 pretty 的最高级，作定语修饰 route。
vocab_pack.example_en: This is the prettiest little village I've ever visited.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这是我去过的最漂亮的小村庄。

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that a particular thing or person receives a special recognition or prize
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 荣誉归于……，……获得这一荣誉
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'That honour goes to the route...' 中，goes 为一般现在时（第三人称单数），短语意为'这一荣誉归于...'。
vocab_pack.example_en: The honour goes to the team that demonstrated the most creativity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这一荣誉属于展现出最多创造力的团队。
vocab_pack.from_passage: That honour goes to the route between Glasgow and Mallaig

vocab_pack.definition_en: to advance or progress in a particular direction
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'the train moved forward' 中，moved 为过去式，forward 为副词。
vocab_pack.example_en: As the train moved forward, the landscape changed dramatically.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随着火车向前行驶，景色发生了巨大变化。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to realize that one is doing something, often unexpectedly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'found myself interacting actively' 中，found 为过去式，myself 为反身代词，interacting 为现在分词作宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She found herself laughing at the joke she had heard before.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她发现自己竟然在笑以前听过的笑话。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to communicate and engage with others in a lively or enthusiastic way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'interacting actively' 为现在分词短语，与 found myself 搭配，描述当时的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students are encouraged to interact actively during group discussions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鼓励学生在小组讨论中积极互动。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to share ideas or opinions with others
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'exchanging thoughts' 为现在分词短语，与前面的 interacting 并列，作 found myself 的补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The event provided a platform for people to exchange thoughts on climate change.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该活动为人们交流对气候变化的看法提供了平台。
vocab_pack.from_passage: exchanging thoughts and even snacks with fellows

vocab_pack.definition_en: to require more time compared to something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'takes longer than flying' 中，takes 为一般现在时（第三人称单数），longer 为比较级，than 引出比较对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: Driving to the city takes longer than taking the train.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 开车去城里比坐火车花的时间更长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A train journey takes longer than flying

vocab_pack.definition_en: a quality that makes something interesting or attractive
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'that's its appeal' 中，appeal 为不可数名词，作表语，与 its 连用表示'它的魅力'。
vocab_pack.example_en: The main appeal of this hotel is its stunning ocean view.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家酒店的主要魅力在于其壮丽的海景。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to feel surprise
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'what will surprise you' 中，surprise 为动词原形，位于 will 之后构成一般将来时。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ending of the movie surprised everyone.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 电影的结尾让所有人都感到意外。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go through a place or area while moving
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'travels through station after station' 中，travels 为一般现在时（第三人称单数），through 为介词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bus travels through several small towns on its way to the capital.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这辆巴士在前往首都的路上经过几个小镇。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as the train travels through station after station

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make time available for a particular purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'provides a perfect time for relaxation' 中，provides 为一般现在时（第三人称单数），a perfect time 为宾语，for 引出目的。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new schedule provides more time for students to rest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新的时间表为学生提供了更多休息时间。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The extended journey provides a perfect time for relaxation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to delay doing something, especially because you do not want to do it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'which people always put off' 中，put off 为短语动词，which 指代 relaxation，作宾语，时态为一般现在时。
vocab_pack.example_en: Don't put off your application until the last minute.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不要把你的申请拖延到最后一刻。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which people always put off due to the tight schedule

vocab_pack.definition_en: describing something that makes you feel tired but is worth the effort
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'it was tiring yet worthwhile' 中，tiring 和 worthwhile 为形容词，由 yet 连接作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The climb was tiring yet worthwhile because of the fantastic view.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这次攀登虽然累，但因为壮观的景色而值得。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to finish a piece of work that you have to do
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'I completed my task' 中，completed 为过去式，my 是形容词性物主代词，task 为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She completed her task ahead of schedule and earned a bonus.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她提前完成了任务，获得了奖金。

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: discovered a new way of traveling
vocab_pack.definition_en: to find a new method or approach to doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'discovered a new way of traveling' 中，discovered 为过去式，a new way of 后接动名词 traveling 作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Through the experiment, we discovered a new way of improving battery life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通过实验，我们发现了一种延长电池寿命的新方法。
vocab_pack.from_passage: discovered a new way of traveling

vocab_pack.definition_en: because of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句 'due to the tight schedule' 中，due to 为介词短语，作原因状语，后接名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The flight was delayed due to bad weather conditions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 航班由于恶劣天气条件而延误。

section_2_word_form.passage:
Du Fu is to Chinese literature what Shakespeare is to English literary tradition, and the great poet who wrote in the eighth century during the Tang dynasty [56] (quote) widely in China today. Unlike English literature of that period — think Beowulf, which is not understood and read by readers of modern English, Du Fu's poetry remains a classic easy [57] (understand) for modern Chinese readers.
However, no complete translation of his work was [58] (access) to foreigners until Stephen Owen, a Harvard professor, completed the six-volume, 3,000-page translation of The Poetry of Du Fu in 2016, [59] challenging task which took him 10 years to finish. In order to preserve [60] (various) in the collection's poetic voices, Owen thought of himself translating a great play with many characters. Doing it all himself, he explained, [61] (allow) him to notice literary allusions(典故) across centuries, linking each text back to earlier works. Those references can easily be lost, and this is [62] happens when a scholar-translator only works on a single volume.
Usually [63] (consider) one of the most challenging works to translate, Du Fu's collection of poetry features breadth in many aspects, whether in the choice of the subject, the way he conveys(传达) different registers [64] the use of layered meanings. Owen's critical translation faces the original texts, [65] (bring) a scholarly aid for the first time to English-speaking readers ready to engage with China's literary lion.

questions.explanation: 考查动词的时态和语态。主语是the great poet (指代杜甫)，与动词quote(引用)是被动关系；同时由时间状语today可知，应用一般现在时的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(is quoted)：语境句：Confucius is quoted widely by scholars all over the world. 固定搭配：quote from, quote sb as saying。原词quote其它变形：quotation(n. 引语), misquote(v. 误引)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。此处是“形容词(easy) + 不定式(to do)”结构，表示主语在某方面具备某种特征。杜甫的诗对于现代读者来说是“容易去理解的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to understand)：语境句：The instructions are clear and easy to understand. 固定搭配：easy to understand, difficult to understand。原词understand其它变形：understanding(n./adj. 理解/善解人意的), understandable(adj. 可理解的)

questions.explanation: 考查形容词转换。在系动词was后作表语，且搭配介词to，be accessible to意为“对……来说是可理解的/可获得的”。给出词access需变为形容词accessible。
questions.supplement: 正确形(accessible)：语境句：The museum is fully accessible to people in wheelchairs. 固定搭配：be accessible to, easily accessible。原词access其它变形：access(n./v. 接近/获取), inaccessibility(n. 不可达)

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。空格处引导同位语“___ challenging task...”，用以解释说明前面的translation(翻译工作)。task是可数名词单数，且此处表泛指“一项具有挑战性的任务”，用不定冠词a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：Completing the marathon was a challenging task for him. 固定搭配：a challenging task, a variety of。相关辨析：a用在辅音音素开头前，an用在元音音素开头前。

questions.explanation: 考查名词转换。作动词preserve(保留)的宾语，需要用名词形式。表示“保留诗歌声音的多样性”，various对应的名词是variety。
questions.supplement: 正确形(variety)：语境句：The shopping mall offers a wide variety of goods. 固定搭配：a variety of, cultural variety。原词various其它变形：variously(adv. 不同地), vary(v. 变化)

questions.explanation: 考查谓语动词。句子主语是动名词短语Doing it all himself，插入语是he explained，本空缺谓语动词。结合全文讲述斯蒂芬·欧文过去翻译杜甫诗集的事迹，应用一般过去时。
questions.supplement: 正确形(allowed)：语境句：The scholarship allowed her to continue her education abroad. 固定搭配：allow sb to do sth, allow for。原词allow其它变形：allowance(n. 津贴), allowable(adj. 允许的)

questions.explanation: 考查名词性从句。空处引导表语从句，且在从句中作happens的主语，表示“……的事情”，故填what。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：What you said yesterday really touched my heart. 固定搭配：what happens, what to do。相关辨析：that在名词性从句中不充当成分，what充当主宾表语。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词作状语。逻辑主语是Du Fu's collection of poetry，它与consider之间是被动关系（被认为），故用过去分词形式表示被动和状态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(considered)：语境句：Considered a masterpiece, the painting is highly valued by collectors. 固定搭配：be considered to be/as, all things considered。原词consider其它变形：consideration(n. 考虑), considerable(adj. 相当大的)

questions.explanation: 考查连词。前文有whether引导条件状语从句“whether in the choice of the subject, the way he conveys different registers...”，这里列举了三个方面，固定句型是whether A, B or C（不管是A、B还是C）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(or)：语境句：We have to decide whether to stay here or leave immediately. 固定搭配：whether...or..., either...or...。相关辨析：and表并列递进，or表选择。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。逗号前句子结构完整(Owen's translation faces texts)，此处表示伴随的结果或状态，翻译本身“带来”帮助，为主动关系，故用现在分词。
questions.supplement: 正确形(bringing)：语境句：The heavy rain lasted for days, bringing severe floods to the area. 固定搭配：bring about, bring up。原词bring其它变形：brought(过去式/过去分词)

vocab_pack.definition_en: to repeat words from a text or speech
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，quoted 为过去分词，与 is 构成一般现在时被动结构（is quoted）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The president's speech was widely quoted in the media.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 总统的演讲被媒体广泛引用。

vocab_pack.definition_en: straightforward to comprehend
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语作后置定语，修饰名词 classic。
vocab_pack.example_en: The instructions are easy to follow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些说明很容易遵循。

vocab_pack.definition_en: able to be reached or used
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 表语形容词，与 was 构成系表结构（was accessible）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum is accessible to visitors with disabilities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆对残疾游客开放。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of being diverse or having different forms
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，作动词 preserve 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The garden has a wide variety of flowers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 花园里有种类繁多的花。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to permit; give permission
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式，作谓语，主语 he，表示过去允许。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher allowed us to use dictionaries during the test.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师允许我们在考试中使用字典。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to think of or regard as
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作状语，表示被动含义（被看作）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Considered a masterpiece, the painting was sold for millions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这幅画被视为杰作，以数百万价格售出。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to carry or convey something to a place or person
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词作结果状语，表示伴随或结果。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new policy brings improved efficiency.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新政策带来了效率的提升。

vocab_pack.term: A is to B what C is to D
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: Du Fu is to Chinese literature what Shakespeare is to English literary tradition
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to compare two relationships; A's relationship to B is like C's relationship to D
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定句型，is 为一般现在时，what 引导从句，主系表结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: Reading is to the mind what exercise is to the body.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 阅读之于心灵犹如运动之于身体。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Du Fu is to Chinese literature what Shakespeare is to English literary tradition

vocab_pack.definition_en: a body of literary works and conventions passed down through generations
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词 to 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: China has a rich literary tradition spanning thousands of years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 中国有几千年的丰富文学传统。

vocab_pack.definition_en: different from
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词，引导比较状语，后面跟名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Unlike his brother, he is very outgoing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 与他兄弟不同，他非常外向。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Unlike English literature of that period

vocab_pack.definition_en: to look at and comprehend written words
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词，与 understood 并列，构成被动语态（is not understood and read）。注意读音 /red/。
vocab_pack.example_en: This novel is widely read around the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这本小说在世界各地被广泛阅读。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who reads
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数名词，作介词 for 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The book appeals to young readers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这本书吸引年轻读者。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a full translation covering all parts
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: A complete translation of the novel is now available.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部小说的完整翻译现已出版。
vocab_pack.from_passage: no complete translation of his work

vocab_pack.definition_en: a difficult and demanding job
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作同位语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Completing the project was a challenging task.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 完成这个项目是一项具有挑战性的任务。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a challenging task which took him 10 years

vocab_pack.definition_en: to require a certain amount of time for someone to accomplish something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 took，him 为间接宾语，10 years 为时间，to finish 为动词不定式。
vocab_pack.example_en: It took her three hours to finish the report.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她花了三个小时完成报告。

vocab_pack.definition_en: for the purpose of; so as to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 目的状语，后接动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: She studied hard in order to pass the exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她努力学习为了通过考试。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the distinctive style or tone of a poet
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，作介词 in 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Each poet has a unique poetic voice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每位诗人都有独特的诗歌风格。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to imagine oneself in a particular role or activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: think of 的过去式 thought，of 为介词，himself 为宾语，translating 为现在分词作宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He thought of himself winning the championship.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他想象自己赢得冠军。
vocab_pack.from_passage: thought of himself translating a great play

vocab_pack.definition_en: a reference to another literary work
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数名词，作 notice 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The poem is full of literary allusions to Greek mythology.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这首诗充满了对希腊神话的文学典故。

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: linking each text back to earlier works
vocab_pack.definition_en: to connect something to an earlier source or point of reference
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，linking 为现在分词，back to 表示方向。
vocab_pack.example_en: The researcher linked the findings back to previous studies.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 研究者将发现与先前的研究联系起来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: linking each text back to earlier works

vocab_pack.definition_en: to no longer have; fail to keep
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词，构成被动语态 (can be lost)。
vocab_pack.example_en: These traditions can easily be lost over time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些传统很容易随时间被遗忘。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who is both a scholar and a translator
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，作主语（a scholar-translator）。
vocab_pack.example_en: A scholar-translator brings depth to the translation of classic texts.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学者型翻译家为经典文本翻译带来深度。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a scholar-translator only works on a single volume

vocab_pack.definition_en: to devote effort to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 a scholar-translator 为第三人称单数，所以 works 加 s。
vocab_pack.example_en: She works on her research project every day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她每天致力于她的研究项目。

vocab_pack.definition_en: wide range; variety
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，作 features 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The course covers a breadth of topics.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这门课程涵盖广泛的主题。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a variety of language used for a particular purpose or social setting
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数名词，作 conveys 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Formal and informal registers are used in different situations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 正式和非正式语域用于不同场合。

vocab_pack.definition_en: meanings that have multiple levels or depths
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数名词，作 in 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The poem has layered meanings that require careful analysis.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这首诗有多层次含义，需要仔细分析。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a translation that includes scholarly analysis and annotations
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 批判性翻译／学术性翻译
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作主语（Owen's critical translation）。
vocab_pack.example_en: A critical translation provides valuable insights into the original text.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学术性翻译为原文提供宝贵的见解。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Owen's critical translation faces the original texts

vocab_pack.definition_en: to confront; be opposite to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，第三人称单数 faces，作谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The translation faces the challenge of preserving nuances.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 翻译面临保留细微差别的挑战。

vocab_pack.definition_en: on the initial occasion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作状语，修饰 brings。
vocab_pack.example_en: I visited Paris for the first time last summer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 去年夏天我第一次去了巴黎。
vocab_pack.from_passage: bringing a scholarly aid for the first time

vocab_pack.definition_en: a prominent and celebrated writer
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 文学巨匠（直译：文学狮子）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作 with 的宾语（China's literary lion），比喻用法。
vocab_pack.example_en: Shakespeare is considered a literary lion of England.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 莎士比亚被视为英国的文学巨匠。
